title: World Cup Final Set: Spain vs Argentina Sunday at MetLife Stadium
detail: With the final four days away, attention turns to Sunday's championship match: Spain vs Argentina at MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, NJ, kicking off 3:00 PM ET -- the first-ever World Cup final between the two nations. France and England meet first in the third-place playoff, Saturday July 18 at Hard Rock Stadium, Miami Gardens, kickoff 5:00 PM ET.

media.caption: MetLife Stadium prepares to host the 2026 World Cup Final between Spain and Argentina
